_comment: The character select, laid out as the grid it is drawn as — rows of entity ids, so the file looks like the screen. It names the whole intended roster; what exists in data/entities/ decides what can actually be picked, so adding a fighter is adding a directory and their slot was reserved from the start. `null` is a deliberate gap. TBC: the arrangement is ours, not the original's — the ten names are confirmed (see game-overview.md), their positions in the 1996 grid are not.
